members.name: FERN
members.role: Prairie habitat surveyor; patient setups and small openings.

MnLeagueRoom1BeforeText: FERN: I count nests in roadside grass. Most people walk straight past them.
They overlook my team, too. Right up until we find an opening.
Welcome to the ELITE FOUR. Watch closely!
MnLeagueRoom1WonText: There. You saw it before I did. I couldn't close that gap.
MnLeagueRoom1LostText: One opening was enough. Next time, make me work for it.
MnLeagueRoom1AfterText: My team can wait all day for a chance. You made your own.
FLINT is through that door. He won't give ground easily.
MnLeagueRoom1NoRunText: Speak to the registrar first. We battle in order. Everyone gets their turn.
MnLeagueRoom1RematchText: FERN: You know my team now. That makes the little changes matter more.
Let's see which of us notices first!

members.name: FLINT
members.role: Retired underground maintenance worker; deliberate, durable battling.

MnLeagueRoom2BeforeText: FLINT. I used to check mine supports before the day shift went down.
You learn to hear a strain before anything gives.
My team knows how to hold. Let's see where you put the pressure.
MnLeagueRoom2WonText: There goes the brace. You found the weak point.
MnLeagueRoom2LostText: Still holding. There's no shame in stepping back to get your bearings.
MnLeagueRoom2AfterText: Good work. You changed your approach when the first one didn't take.
VEIL is next. Don't mistake a quiet room for an empty one.
MnLeagueRoom2NoRunText: This is the second match. Register, then get past FERN. I'll be here.
MnLeagueRoom2RematchText: FLINT: We patched the weak points. I expect you've done the same.
All right. Put us under load.

members.name: VEIL
members.role: Night search volunteer; observant, restrained and difficult to read.

MnLeagueRoom3BeforeText: I'm VEIL. When a search runs into the night, I take the late shift.
A branch moves. A sound stops. My partners notice before I do.
They've noticed you. Shall we begin?
MnLeagueRoom3WonText: I was watching for your next move. You had already made it.
MnLeagueRoom3LostText: You lost sight of us for a moment. That was all we needed.
MnLeagueRoom3AfterText: You kept looking even when the answer wasn't obvious. I like that.
HALDEN waits beyond the door. Give him my regards.
MnLeagueRoom3NoRunText: The first two matches come before mine. The registrar can help you begin.
MnLeagueRoom3RematchText: VEIL: I remember how you broke through last time.
Don't worry. I won't ask you to show me the same thing twice.

members.name: HALDEN
members.role: Canoe guide; reads momentum and commits when the current turns.

MnLeagueRoom4BeforeText: HALDEN. Last of the four. I guide canoe trips when I'm not here.
A big current doesn't care how strong you are. Pick your moment, then commit.
You've made it this far. Show me how you finish!
MnLeagueRoom4WonText: I committed first. You turned the whole match around.
MnLeagueRoom4LostText: You fought the current too long. Come back with another way across.
MnLeagueRoom4AfterText: That's four. Take a breath. Check every partner before you go on.
CASEY is waiting. And yes, the champion is every bit that good.
MnLeagueRoom4NoRunText: I'm the fourth match. Get through the other three first. No short carries.
MnLeagueRoom4RematchText: HALDEN: Back through all three rooms? Good. You haven't skipped the hard part.
One more crossing before CASEY. Let's go!

members.name: CASEY
members.role: Champion who separates public duty from sporting proof; direct, competitive and generous in defeat.

MnLeagueChampionBeforeText: CASEY: The trail to ELY is open again. I've been looking forward to meeting you.
What you did out there matters. But it won't win this battle for you.
Here, you and your partners get to show what you can do.
I'm the CHAMPION. I'm going to make you earn this!
MnLeagueChampionWonText: I thought I could turn it around. You never let me. You won!
MnLeagueChampionLostText: You reached this room once. You can do it again. I'll be waiting.
MnLeagueChampionAfterText: I kept one answer in reserve. Then you made me use it. Then you beat it.
Go north. Every partner who brought you here belongs in that record.
The next time we battle, I'll be the one coming for your title!
MnLeagueChampionNoRunText: CASEY: Beat all four in one registered run. I want to meet that whole team at its best.
MnLeagueChampionRematchText: CASEY: CHAMPION! That still sounds strange when I'm saying it to someone else.
I've replayed our match in my head. Now let's see how much that helped!

MnElyRegistrationText: The ELITE FOUR are FERN, FLINT, VEIL and HALDEN. CASEY holds the title.
Five battles. Bring your own supplies. Leaving or losing ends this run.
MnElyBadgeDeniedText: Eight badges earn a place in the League challenge.
Until then, the clinic and shop are open. Come back when you're ready.
MnElySurveyDeniedText: The survey link is still down. We can't open the challenge until the trail is safe.
MnElyRegistrationDeclinedText: No rush. The clinic is free. Check your supplies, too. CASEY can wait.

MnElyRecordText: Five victories. One team. Let's put every name in the record.
The work outside isn't finished. The lakes and the people there will need time.
But this is yours. Welcome to the HALL OF FAME!
MnElyRecordDeniedText: A new record needs five victories in one registered run. Your past records stay here.
